findingDetails.title: Pre-existing untracked deletions disappear from the baseline diff
findingDetails.evidence: The detector iterates current status entries only.
findingDetails.recommendation: Compare baseline/current path union and preserve baseline bytes for a missing path.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Detector and baseline contract are in scope.

findingDetails.title: Failed or incomplete lanes skip containment entirely
findingDetails.recommendation: Invoke containment in a failure-safe path before rethrowing.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Runner ordering controls target CLI lineages.

findingDetails.title: Quarantine destinations are not canonicalized before trusted writes
findingDetails.evidence: The writer joins fixed and nested destinations without destination realpath validation.
findingDetails.recommendation: Validate every trusted destination against the canonical artifact root before mkdir or write.
findingDetails.scopeProof: NFR-S01 explicitly governs this trusted writer.

findingDetails.title: Command caller migration still contains removed worktree assumptions and raw state writes
findingDetails.evidence: The auto review branch rejects shared checkout and appends recovery state directly; related branches retain divergent inline containment paths.
findingDetails.recommendation: Migrate all four command YAMLs to the current shared-checkout gateway-only contract.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Phase 007 explicitly covers command YAML migration.

findingDetails.title: Canonical packet records disagree about isolation state
findingDetails.evidence: Goal and accepted ADRs say isolation is off or removed while parent requirements and closure records describe worktree default-on behavior.
findingDetails.recommendation: Publish one authoritative post-ADR-007 contract and supersede obsolete closure claims.
findingDetails.scopeProof: The cited packet docs are canonical state surfaces.

findingDetails.title: Churn threshold rationale contradicts executable defaults
findingDetails.evidence: Rationale says 12/40 while REQ-004 and executor-config ship 3/12.
findingDetails.recommendation: Reconcile rationale, requirement, schema defaults, and acceptance evidence.
findingDetails.scopeProof: The thresholds govern shared-checkout safety and are in the target packet.

findingDetails.title: Quarantine evidence is a mutable single snapshot across retries
findingDetails.evidence: The writer uses one fixed quarantine path and explicitly replaces the manifest and named files on later passes.
findingDetails.recommendation: Use an attempt- or iteration-keyed quarantine directory or an append-only immutable manifest and retain prior evidence.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: A latest-only snapshot may be enough for one pass, but runner retries and repeated sweeps can overwrite the only historical record.
findingDetails.scopeProof: The repeated writer path is in the target runner's containment lifecycle.

findingDetails.title: Boundary regression tests omit the destination and failure seams
findingDetails.evidence: The reviewed tests cover target-side symlinks and ordinary quarantine writes but not trusted destination symlinks, baseline-only untracked deletion, or failed-lane containment.
findingDetails.recommendation: Add focused regression cases for each missing seam and keep the failure outcome separate from containment evidence.
findingDetails.scopeProof: The test file is the packet's cited containment unit suite.
